title: Elevators/airport
content: I had AI create a image of what the elevators look like in mall world and this is very accurate, the elevator I have to take was loooooong (kind of like space needle in Seattle) and the inside of the “plane” was a circle of seats like the pic shows but with the backs together instead of facing towards each other. Very dark/sleek/futuristic looking. Does anyone else’s look similar to mine?
